reachability_matrix.callsite_analysis: ChromaDB is not directly imported anywhere in src/. AmberClaw core runtime uses SQLite SessionDB (session_db.py) and aiosqlite. ChromaDB is an optional vector store provider wrapped behind path-sanitized mock disk defenses in memory_manager.py.
reachability_matrix.compensating_controls: Chroma server API is not exposed. Mock disk isolation and temporary directory fixtures enforced in memory/memory_manager.py and tests/unit/engine/test_task_cancel.py.

reachability_matrix.callsite_analysis: Zero direct imports across src/ and tests/. Pulled transitively by litellm and h2o. Default pickle serialization defect requires local file write access to cache directory by untrusted local users.
reachability_matrix.compensating_controls: No diskcache directories are created or read by AmberClaw; filesystem permissions restrict workspace directories to running user (0700).

reachability_matrix.callsite_analysis: Zero direct imports across src/ and tests/. Used transitively by datasets, litellm, huggingface-hub, and safety. Defect requires shared world-writable directories (0777 without sticky bit) allowing local symlink planting.
reachability_matrix.compensating_controls: Linux kernel fs.protected_regular=2 and fs.protected_hardlinks=1 active. Verification lock uses system flock binary on dedicated .planning/verification.lock, not python filelock library.

reachability_matrix.callsite_analysis: Imported strictly within optional autonomous data-science team module (src/amberclaw/data/tools/h2o.py, h2o_ml_agent.py). Not imported by core agent loop, API gateway, CLI, or memory.
reachability_matrix.compensating_controls: h2o cluster initialization requires explicit data-science execution; excluded from standard agent loop and API entrypoints; targeted for amberclaw[data] optional extra.
